note: Measured off animations/Savannah/Savannah riggin png.png with png-read.js,
not picked by eye. Every number is a FRACTION of the figure and never a
length: yN is height with 0 at the sole and 1 at the crown, ax is |x| over
the fingertip reach, zN is depth over height. All read in the T-pose. That
is what lets the same spec paint the model at any scale — and the model is
stored at a hundredth of life size, to match the animation clips.
The drawing is stylised rather than a render of this mesh: its vertical
landmarks agree with the skeleton to about a percent, its widths are out by
over ten. So heights come from the picture and widths from the rig.
